title: Special repairs and civil maintenance of Lighthouse tower, allied buildings and compound wall etc. at Ammapattinam Lighthouse station.
summary: Percentage-rate e-tender for special repairs and civil maintenance of the lighthouse tower, allied buildings and compound wall at Ammapattinam Lighthouse, Pudukkottai district, Tamil Nadu.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Deep Bhavan, 5/20 Jaffer Syrang Street, Chennai

sites.name: Ammapattinam Lighthouse, Pudukkottai (District), Tamilnadu
sites.work: Special repairs and civil maintenance of tower, allied buildings and compound wall

scope.item: Special repairs and civil maintenance of Lighthouse tower, allied buildings and compound wall etc. (no BOQ in this notice)

money.notes: Estimated cost including 18% GST. EMD by DD/FDR of scheduled/nationalized bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai, payable at Chennai; table says valid three months from technical bid opening while note 1.1 says 30 days (Hindi: 90 days). Tender fee and EMD exempted for valid MSME/NSIC certificate.

period.bid_validity: 90 days from date of opening of technical bid

eligibility: Valid registration in appropriate category & class with CPWD, State PWD, Railways, MES, BSNL or other State/Central Government/PSU/autonomous bodies

Similar works completed in last seven years: three works each >= 40% of estimated cost, or two each >= 50%, or one >= 80%; only fully completed works with completion certificates; values updated at 7% per annum; certificates from officers below Executive Engineer not considered
Similar works = repairs and civil maintenance of building or construction of any building/compound wall/retaining wall/RCC work
Average annual turnover on construction works at least 40% of estimated cost over last 3 financial years ending 31 March 2024, CA certified
Key technical personnel for supervision; unconditional tender undertaking (Annexure III); tender acceptance letter (Annexure II); affidavit of not blacklisted
List of relatives serving in MoPSW or DGLL; Make in India self-certification (Annexure VI)
notes: Section I NIT only; no BOQ. Bid download and submission 08.08.2024 10:00 to 29.08.2024 15:00. EMD validity stated inconsistently (three months / 90 days / 30 days). Hindi text layer partly garbled; English parallel.
